description: Patch operations approved for the blender-vse Skill. Project and revision fields belong to the outer MCP tool call.

policy_exclusions.apply_patch: the outer blender_patch tool already owns the transaction
policy_exclusions.batch: the outer blender_patch command list is already atomic
policy_exclusions.configure_vse_layout: visible-session setup owns the editor layout
policy_exclusions.save_project: a successful outer patch saves the project
